entities.summary: The Kerbelayi Abdulla Mosque is a former mosque and historical architectural monument, located at 155 Dilara Aliyeva Street in Baku, the capital city of Azerbaijan. Built in 1894 by philanthropist Abdulla Zerbaliyev, the mosque was included in the list of local significant immovable historical and cultural monuments by the decision No. 132 of the Cabinet of Azerbaijan on August 2, 2001.
